inventory_movement_reservation_type.name: inventory_movement_reservation_type
inventory_movement_reservation_type.value: ("inventory_movements"."type" = 'RESERVATION' AND "inventory_movements"."reservation_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("inventory_movements"."type" = 'RESERVATION_RELEASE' AND "inventory_movements"."reservation_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "inventory_movements"."type" = 'SALE' OR ("inventory_movements"."type" NOT IN ('RESERVATION', 'RESERVATION_RELEASE', 'SALE') AND "inventory_movements"."reservation_id" IS NULL)

inventory_movement_delta.name: inventory_movement_delta
inventory_movement_delta.value:
CASE
    WHEN "inventory_movements"."type" IN ('OPENING_STOCK', 'PURCHASE', 'RETURN', 'ADJUSTMENT_IN', 'CANCELLED_ORDER_RESTOCK') THEN "inventory_movements"."after_on_hand" - "inventory_movements"."before_on_hand" = "inventory_movements"."quantity" AND "inventory_movements"."after_reserved" = "inventory_movements"."before_reserved"
    WHEN "inventory_movements"."type" = 'RESERVATION' THEN "inventory_movements"."after_on_hand" = "inventory_movements"."before_on_hand" AND "inventory_movements"."after_reserved" - "inventory_movements"."before_reserved" = "inventory_movements"."quantity"
    WHEN "inventory_movements"."type" = 'RESERVATION_RELEASE' THEN "inventory_movements"."after_on_hand" = "inventory_movements"."before_on_hand" AND "inventory_movements"."before_reserved" - "inventory_movements"."after_reserved" = "inventory_movements"."quantity"
    WHEN "inventory_movements"."type" = 'SALE' AND "inventory_movements"."reservation_id" IS NOT NULL THEN "inventory_movements"."before_on_hand" - "inventory_movements"."after_on_hand" = "inventory_movements"."quantity" AND "inventory_movements"."before_reserved" - "inventory_movements"."after_reserved" = "inventory_movements"."quantity"
    ELSE "inventory_movements"."before_on_hand" - "inventory_movements"."after_on_hand" = "inventory_movements"."quantity" AND "inventory_movements"."after_reserved" = "inventory_movements"."before_reserved" END

order_items_valid.name: order_items_valid
order_items_valid.value: "order_items"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000 AND "order_items"."unit_price" >= 0 AND ("order_items"."unit_cost" IS NULL OR "order_items"."unit_cost" >= 0)

orders_valid.name: orders_valid
orders_valid.value: "orders"."status" IN ('pending','fulfilled','cancelled') AND "orders"."payment_status" IN ('unpaid','paid','refunded') AND ("orders"."status" <> 'fulfilled' OR "orders"."payment_status" = 'paid') AND ("orders"."status" <> 'cancelled' OR "orders"."payment_status" <> 'paid') AND "orders"."subtotal" >= 0 AND "orders"."discount" >= 0 AND "orders"."discount" <= "orders"."subtotal" AND "orders"."shipping_fee" >= 0 AND "orders"."total" = "orders"."subtotal" - "orders"."discount" + "orders"."shipping_fee"

promotions_valid.name: promotions_valid
promotions_valid.value: "promotions"."code" ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_-]{1,39}$' AND "promotions"."kind" IN ('percent','fixed') AND "promotions"."amount" > 0 AND ("promotions"."kind" <> 'percent' OR "promotions"."amount" <= 100) AND "promotions"."minimum" >= 0 AND "promotions"."ends_at" > "promotions"."starts_at" AND "promotions"."usage_limit" > 0 AND "promotions"."used" >= 0 AND "promotions"."used" <= "promotions"."usage_limit"
